notes.note: Label of the field for the length of the prefixes a delegation pool hands to routers (IPv6).
Help under the delegated length field of a delegation pool; {length} is the prefix length of the network.

segment.source: The length of the prefixes handed to routers, for example 56 or 60. Longer than /{length} and at most /64.

notes.note: Error under the delegated length field when it is empty.

segment.source: Enter the length of the delegated prefixes, for example 60.

notes.note: Error under the delegated length field when it is not a whole number.

segment.source: Enter a whole number, for example 60.

notes.note: Error under the delegated length field when it is out of range; {length} is the prefix length of the network.

segment.source: The length must be longer than /{length} and at most /64.

notes.note: Error under the first address of a delegation pool when it does not start a prefix of the delegated length; {len} is that length.

segment.source: The first address must be the first address of a /{len} prefix.

notes.note: Error under the last address of a delegation pool when it does not end a prefix of the delegated length; {len} is that length.

segment.source: The last address must be the last address of a /{len} prefix.

segment.source: A delegation pool hands whole prefixes to routers that ask for them (prefix delegation, RFC 8415). It is an IPAM range of the role Delegation pool: it is made here or on the page of the network, and moved and deleted on that page.

segment.source: The pool is made as a range of {network} in IPAM. It must start and end on boundaries of the delegated length.
